blurb: Aqua Toys Rentals offers premium tritoon pontoon boats and Yamaha WaveRunners for water adventures on Lake of the Ozarks. They provide rentals of 24, 28, and 32 foot tritoon pontoon boats, as well as tubes, knee boards, skis, and aqua pads. Located near the Grand Glaize Bridge at the 20.5-mile marker, they serve guests looking for cruising or thrill rides.
